description: This file implements the MediaPlayerManager class, which manages media player clients, including creation, control acquisition, and release, using GStreamer objects and backend interfaces.

classes.name: MediaPlayerManager
classes.description: Manages media player clients, handling their lifecycle, control, and communication with GStreamer objects.

classes.name: MediaPlayerClientInfo
classes.description: Holds information about a media player client, including the client object, controller, and reference count.

methods.name: MediaPlayerManager::attachMediaPlayerClient
methods.description: Attaches a media player client to a specified GstObject parent, creating a new client if necessary.

methods.name: MediaPlayerManager::getMediaPlayerClient
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the current media player client.

methods.name: MediaPlayerManager::hasControl
methods.description: Checks if the manager has control over the current media player client.

methods.name: MediaPlayerManager::releaseMediaPlayerClient
methods.description: Releases the current media player client, decreasing reference count and cleaning up if needed.

methods.name: MediaPlayerManager::acquireControl
methods.description: Attempts to acquire control of a media player client if no controller exists.

methods.name: MediaPlayerManager::createMediaPlayerClient
methods.description: Creates and registers a new media player client associated with a GstObject parent.
